frontier.hypothesis: Directed permuter over PERM_STMT_LIST reorderings of the non-v1 init statements (sum, s4, i, count, s5) with weight overrides on perm_add_sub, perm_split_assignment, perm_dummy_comma_expr can find a closing form the hand-derivation has provably not reached.
frontier.mechanism: The sched2 tie is decided by INSN_LUID (s3 CONFIRMED, sched.c:2398-2456). Every hand-derived C spelling either satisfies the tie by rotating RA (bad) or by adding a CSE-move copy (bad). A permuter sweep over the statement-ordering cross-product with expression-spelling mutation covers a search space beyond hand-reach in a neighborhood the s3/s4 near-hits mark as promising.
frontier.next_probe: Hand-build the permuter workspace using tools/mar_perm_workspace.sh as template: (1) cpp-preprocess src/text1a_c.c into base.c (with the func_80044010 __asm__ block preserved as file-scope asm since GCC accepts it there); (2) extract target's 83 insns from disc/SLUS_006.63 @ 0x35A94 into target.s + assemble to target.o; (3) settings.toml with func_name=func_80045294 and weight_overrides emphasizing perm_stmt_list, perm_add_sub, perm_dummy_comma_expr, perm_reorder_decls; (4) launch via tools/permuter_campaign.py launch --stop-on-zero with fresh-seed discipline (20-30 min basins). Alternative: temporarily replace the __asm__ block with a stub C function for import.py's parse, then patch base.c.

frontier.hypothesis: A CSE-move-copy-elision path exists at RA (global.c coalesce_pseudos) that could absorb the +1 insn in the cse-fold-anon-shift.c / late-v1-assign-with-s4-inline.c near-hits without changing the target schedule.
frontier.mechanism: The +1 CSE-move copy in both near-hits is `move v1,v0` where v0 is an anonymous pseudo holding a0<<4 and v1 is the declared pseudo. If a spelling can cause global.c to coalesce v0 and v1 into the same hard reg (so no move is needed), the near-hits close.
frontier.next_probe: Instrumented `cc1 -da base.i` on cse-fold-anon-shift.c to dump greg/reload; check whether v0 and v1 are marked non-coalescable and why. If they are coalescable in principle, seek a C-spelling that makes global.c see them as a single equivalence class. Read tools/gcc-2.7.2/global.c:coalesce_pseudos + reload flow for the coalesce precondition.
